# HTML named-character references

Unmodified WHATWG table downloaded from https://html.spec.whatwg.org/entities.json
on 2026-11-16. The 2,125 semicolon-terminated entries generate the native
`marksy/named_entities` lookup. Legacy semicolonless names are intentionally
excluded: CommonMark requires the semicolon.

SHA-256: `d741d877ac77c4194c4ad526b5b4a19aef8dfe411ab840a466891cdbb9f362e6`

The entity test reads this original table independently and checks all 2,125
required names, including multi-code-point values.
